styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate does not read as a 4x3 ground patch. The measured facts are acceptable: 7 visible tones per tile (equal to the paving reference, above the grass reference's 3), 4% near-flat coverage, and 0% neutral dark edges, so the outline is tinted brown rather than near-black. Against that, the whole piece has only 9 distinct colours and about 4 lightness steps on the sand ramp, versus about 5-6 in Beodeul materials. The dark rim around a flat-looking form gives a mild sticker feel, and the piece lacks the surface variation of the references. Because of the kind mismatch and the shallow shading and texture, I fail it.
